guarantees.topology: Build and capacity-check all live hazards before choosing ascending live order only if every edge is strictly forward. This equals existing smallest-ready Kahn order. Backward/self edges keep sorted CSR, heap and cycle behavior; diagnostics sort edges independently.
guarantees.final_contents: Reuse first dataflow contents only when every pass remains in exact declaration order. Culling or reordering keeps full initial-state replay. Initial input/read validation and optional lifetimes remain.
guarantees.intervals: Checked one-based NonZeroUsize indices preserve all non-ZST Vec-representable indices, free slots and capacity limits. Local adjacent insertion avoids a second root search; parent/root links are updated before stopping at unchanged subtree height.
guarantees.whole_resource: A complete-frontier guard excludes partial prefix/suffix/interior. Detach only that resource, postorder recycle its Copy nodes with height-bounded recursion, and reuse a node. Existing nodes guarantee replacement capacity; other resources and free slots remain valid.

preparation_cpu_fixture_requested_bytes.note: Requested allocator bytes at preparation, not resident/peak/VRAM; normal24frame alloc/alloc_zeroed/realloc/dealloc remain zero.

benchmark.configuration: No features; rustc -O edition2024; only measurement processes pinned to logical CPU mask0x1;100ms common process warmup, then8warmups and9samples per scenario; clocks/priority not fixed. Final run order baseline2b, pipeline-only, final, then original array reference.
benchmark.measured_scope: Only public Graph::compile, except separately named explicit_dependency_insertion. Pool/asset/snapshot preparation, Graph construction, compiled plan destruction and result return are outside timing; lifecycle allocation gates separately cover normal complete processing.
benchmark.scenarios: 16/128/1024/2048/4096/8192 gapped writes in ascending/descending/fixed-seed shuffled order; adjacent writes plus whole read; backwards disjoint DAG; overwritten culled writers; FrameSnapshot::build_graph with1/128/1024 distinct tiny triangle meshes,8192/1024draws,2Compute passes,readback and optional deadbranch.

initial_without_process_warmup.note: Preserved first run with only per-case warmup. Apparent small-case regressions did not persist with the common100ms process warmup. Clock/scheduling/background contributions were not isolated; no causal CPU-frequency claim.

reproduction: Write harness_source_utf8 to scaling.rs and create isolated checkouts at each listed source commit.
Run each variant separately from builds/native gates and keep every raw sample. The harness pins only itself, asserts live pass counts, and emits JSON lines.
limits: Synthetic CPU compile time only; no full frame/GPU/FPS/Bistro or all-input performance claim.
Smallest Engine case is near the100ns clock granularity; one-tick differences are not a demonstrated regression or speedup.
No fixed wall-clock CI thresholds; initial unwarmed results are retained. No arbitrary plan-cache replay benchmark.
